name: Mountain Avatar's triggered Earthen Avatar clears the client's false cooldown (#9674)
contract: Mountain Avatar (707616) procs Earthen Avatar (680421) via CastSpell(owner, EarthenAvatar,
TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK) with no cast item. Spell::SendSpellCooldown skips registering a server
cooldown for a TRIGGERED_IGNORE_SPELL_AND_CATEGORY_CD cast with no cast item, so cooldown_ms for
680421 stays 0 (confirmed, already correct) -- but the client still starts its own local 180s swipe
from observing the SMSG_SPELL_GO for 680421, since nothing tells it otherwise (client lab evidence,
true) right after the triggered cast, matching the existing AscensionRunemasterEchoes.cpp:208 pattern,
which calls Player::SendClearCooldown and so emits SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN (opcode 0x1DE/478) for 680421.
Mountain Avatar's proc chance is a genuine 5% roll (spell_proc Chance=5), so Geode (803138) is cast
repeatedly to make the false-failure probability negligible (spell_cast_count is used rather than
spell_proc_count because PreventDefaultAction() in the script means the native proc-cast-count never
attributes the cast to the aura, per the gameplay-test README's own guidance for that case).
